tags: An enquiry set out as a title block
features: The finished buildings fill the screen, so the work is judged at the size it was built
Each building sits beside a drawing that draws itself, which shows the thinking clients are paying for
One house is told slowly, with numbered spots linked across photo, plan and list
The enquiry is the practice's own title block and issues a reference, so it reads as the start of a project
name: Atelier Voss
short: An architect's portfolio where every building sits beside a drawing that draws itself.
long: Atelier Voss opens on a finished house with the practice name across it. Pick a building in the index and its photo fills the screen while its drawing draws itself on a sheet. Halvard House is then told slowly, with numbered spots lighting up on photo and plan together, and the enquiry is the practice's own title block.
proves: Real photography and technical drawing on the same page, so a visitor sees both the finished building and the thinking behind it.
story: An architect sells the drawing and the building. This site shows both, side by side, and links them point by point.
